compensating_controls.fallback_used: Native analyzers per stack: Roslyn (.NET), eslint-plugin-security (Node), bandit (Python), gosec (Go), PHP dangerous-pattern grep + project-local PHPStan (php.sh)
Stack-native: dotnet list package --vulnerable, npm audit, pip-audit, govulncheck, composer audit
Defer to /infra when image is built
Use safety as alternative; or pip list --outdated + manual CVE check
Use ruff --select S (bandit-like rules) or semgrep p/python
Use staticcheck + manual review of go.sum vs CVE database
